args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Every check that was run passed in all 8.
Cleared (6): r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06.
- r01, r03, r04 and r05 sit at the batch median on every summary.
- r02 is a faster root. Its REGR peak is 112.16 %/h, against a batch median of 53.28. Its peak position (421 µm) and growth-zone length (684 µm) match the batch. It used stride 1, so the time base is not the cause.
- r06's largest flank difference sits at 84 µm. Plane sections passed (1.64 vs 3.25), so that difference matches the curvature rate. Its growth zone is 10 µm shorter (674 µm), a small difference.
Flagged (2): r07 and r08, reason width_free_ratio_used.
- Their largest width-free ratio is +0.093 at 50 µm from the tip. The batch median is −0.035, so the sign is flipped.
- Their plane-sections value (1.64 vs 3.25) would have passed, which shows width was close to constant and the width-free ratio was not needed.
What the flagged runs share: the same centre and flank profile as r06 (flank difference largest at 84 µm, growth zone 674 µm). On these runs the width-free ratio does not fit the strain-rate and curvature-rate measurement.
